Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.85

- The Auto update ETA is more accurate: it now counts retainers finished in the new-listing pass, ignores time spent waiting for your price decisions, and scales by each retainer's listings.
- The plugin version now shows at the top of the ? tab.
- Universalis requests now identify the real plugin version.
